author: reek
body: Visibility culling. Extracts six frustum planes from the view- projection matrix, tests AABBs against the frustum, and performs backface culling using screen-space winding order.

author: reek
body: The plane coefficients come straight out of a Mat4, which is Real, so they are Real. They were integers from the era when Mat4 was fixed-point, which is why extraction could not type-check at all: every one of the twenty-four coefficients was a Real being dropped into an integer field. A normalized plane's a, b and c are a unit normal and d is a signed distance in world units, so the AABB test below is a plain dot product with no thousandths in it.
